target_review.notes: Compared the complete problem.md, selected target, proof-context, basis proof and replacement map with the frozen spec and P. H001-H006 retain primality; characteristic; the integer range 0≤λ<p; the complex irreducible highest-weight representation and dimension; every Chevalley normalization and highest-weight-vector condition; and an arbitrary admissible lattice stable under all divided powers. Parameters carry ambient structures, not concealed nonzero/range/preservation assumptions. P retains nonzeroness and the universal invariant-subspace dichotomy for the original M⊗_ℤ K and L(K) action. No algebraic closure, minimal lattice, p>2, or λ>0 is imposed. The unused complex-irreducibility component of H004 remains present (its dimension component is used); no whole original H is removed. The authorized 2basis route preserves the coordinate argument, replaces localization and the common-coordinate-module/rank/principality arguments by denominator-cleared integer identities and direct scalar extension, identifies the tensor orders explicitly, and uses the internal dimension/matrix-unit simplicity lemma. B101→N001, B102→N002, B103→N003/N004, B104→N005, B105→P retain their mathematical content. All class-3 results have internal producers. The basis metadata and native-leaf checks are not treated as proofs of those internal implications.

D001.notes: ell=Int.toNat(λ) is defined for every integer λ. Identification of its integer image with λ is explicitly conditional on nonnegativity, retained in H003; no range assumption is hidden.

D002.notes: n=ell+1 is an unconditional natural-number definition. Positivity follows from this expression and is explicitly exported in N001/N003, rather than imposed on a parameter.

D003.notes: I is the finite index set 0≤i≤ell, identified with Fin(ell+1). The definition distinguishes natural index arithmetic from integer weight subtraction, including the endpoint ell=0.

D004.notes: X_r=(r!)⁻¹x^r is a complex-linear endomorphism for every natural r. Complex factorials are nonzero; composition order is explicit. No invertibility in characteristic p is granted.

D005.notes: Y_r=(r!)⁻¹y^r is defined over ℂ for every natural r with the same legitimate factorial convention as X. Reduction formulas are subsequent internal results.

D006.notes: U_Z is the original integer subalgebra generated by all abstract divided powers, with its represented actions X,Y specified. Stability is retained as H006, rather than asserted by this definition.

D007.notes: U=M⊗_ℤ K uses the given additive subgroup as its integer module and places the K-action on the K factor. The induced map is defined only for an actual integer endomorphism of M, so it does not assume lattice preservation by arbitrary complex operators.

D008.notes: L_K and its action retain the original integral Chevalley construction, including characteristic 2. H005,H006 are explicit guards: x,y preserve M by admissibility, and h=xy−yx preserves M by the commutator relation. These facts are exported in N002; the definition adds no preservation hypothesis.

D009.notes: e_i=Y_i v is a well-defined family on I. It asserts neither nonzeroness nor a basis; these are internal conclusions of N001 under the original representation hypotheses.

D010.notes: c_j=binom(ell,j) is defined for j∈I as a natural integer, with its scalar image in K explicitly distinguished. Positivity and nonzero reduction are subsequent N002/N003 conclusions.

D011.notes: C is the finite product of the c_j on I, with a specified empty-product convention. No nonzero or invertibility property is built into the definition.

D012.notes: d_i is the product of c_j with j≠i. The singleton case gives 1. Its relation C=c_i d_i is an internal exported equality, not an extra root.

D013.notes: Q=Y_ell X_ell is a legitimate composition of defined complex endomorphisms. The explicit renaming of the basis proof's operator P avoids collision with target ID P; the projection property belongs to N002.

D014.notes: A_ij=X_(ell−i) Q Y_(ell−j) is defined for i,j∈I, so both differences are natural indices in range. This definition does not assume the matrix-unit evaluation or preservation of M.

D015.notes: a_ij is the lattice restriction of A_ij under the explicit H006 guard. Each factor is a divided power, hence preserves M under that guard. Other superscript-M restrictions are used only once preservation is established, with h's existence and commutator exported in N002.

D016.notes: T=K⊗_ℤ M is an unconditional tensor construction with K acting on its own factor. It is distinguished from the original U; the equivalence and intertwining are exported in N004, not silently identified.

D017.notes: hat is canonical base change of an actual ℤ-linear map, with codomain End_K(T). Shorthand for restrictions is expressly conditional on their existence; N002 supplies these restrictions. M007 supplies the pure-tensor formula, and N003 exports the operation identities.

D018.notes: F_ij=(c_j in K)⁻¹hat(a_ij) is a defined K-linear endomorphism under H006. Total field inverse makes its definition legitimate even before nonzeroness is proved; the nonzero coefficients and matrix-unit properties are internal N003 conclusions.
